hero.name: Eric Garcia.
hero.bioStart: I'm a thoughtful junior programmer who is passionate about finding new things to
hero.bioEnd: , and perfecting the ones I already know. This is true whether I'm working on a project, learning about my hobbies, or just bored =).

items.title: Web development
items.description: I develop full-stack web applications using modern technologies such as React, Next.js, and Astro, among others. I have experience in the use of REST APIs, authentication, and database management. I focus on the creation of optimized, secure, and scalable applications.

items.title: AI integration
items.description: The field of artificial intelligence is currently the one that interests me the most. I have knowledge of LLM fundamentals, transformer architectures, fine-tuning, embeddings, RAG, among other techniques. I have experience developing agentic systems for process automation and optimization.

items.title: Task automation
items.description: I have experience in scripting languages such as Python and Bash to automate repetitive tasks, as well as numerical and data processing libraries such as Pandas and NumPy to analyze and process data efficiently and automatically.

items.title: Cloud application deployment
items.description: I have deployed applications on my own remote servers using Docker and hosting services such as DigitalOcean, Vercel, and Heroku. I am also used to using CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions to automate deployment and continuous integration of my applications.

descriptions.aethertype: A distraction-free, local-first writing environment that makes writing a pleasant experience. Step into the aether and write without limits.
descriptions.latentspace: A web application that allows you to explore the latent space representation of a set of words using an open-source embedding model and PCA analysis.
descriptions.conwaylightsim: A cellular automaton web simulator inspired by Conway's Game of Life, featuring interactive editing, real-time simulation, reactive audio and more.
descriptions.macroworth: A web application made for reviewing stocks and ETFs using AI-powered research and analysis.
descriptions.mailresolve: An automated email triage system that classifies incoming emails and performs actions automatically based on the email content.
